verdict.rationale: The evidence implies follow-up messaging into live sessions. Release notes describe collaboratively drafting "responses" to sessions and asking "the session agent" to open a draft PR, and the remote-daemon tutorial says you can control a running task from the web app or a phone. None of it explicitly documents interrupting or steering an agent mid-run without restarting. Missing for 10: explicit docs on sending follow-up or steering messages to an in-progress session, confirmation that this happens without a restart or new session, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
